name: Kawabe de Deatta Tenshi-tachi
original_name: 川辺で出会った天使たち
source:
Will you come to the river to play?
There you'll meet angelic cute young girls.
Her clothes will get wet, so she plays naked. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105930.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你愿意来河边玩吗？
在那里，你会遇见可爱得像天使一样的年轻女孩。
她的衣服会被打湿，所以会脱光衣服玩耍。

[来自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105930.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
